description.value:
When you use Wyrd Time, you gain the following benefits while it is in effect:

  • When you cast a spell that effects other creatures, if the spell requires a saving throw, all targets have Disadvantage on that saving throw. Wyrd Time still ends immediately.
  • When you fail a Saving Throw you can spend 4 Sorcery Points to succeed instead.
  • At the start of your turn, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to gain True Sight out to 30 feet until the end of your turn.
  • You may spend 2 Sorcery Points when you cast Modify Memory. When you do this the creature has Disadvantage on its saving throw and casting the spell doesn’t end Wyrd Time.
